```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sock-shop
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db-secret
  namespace: sock-shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: "change-me-in-production"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
spec:
  selector:
    app: front-end
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8079
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: front-end
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: front-end
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: front-end
          image: weaveworksdemos/front-end:0.3.12
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8079
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 200Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8079
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8079
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: edge-router
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
    - name: admin
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: edge-router
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: edge-router
    spec:
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: edge-router
          image: weaveworksdemos/edge-router:0.1.1
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
            - name: admin
              containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          volumeMounts:
            - name: var-run
              mountPath: /var/run
      volumes:
        - name: var-run
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
spec:
  selector:
    app: catalogue
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: catalogue
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue:0.3.5
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: ZIPKIN
              value: ""
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 200Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue-db
spec:
  selector:
    app: catalogue-db
  ports:
    - name: mysql
      port: 3306
      targetPort: 3306
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue-db
spec:
  serviceName: catalogue-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue-db
    spec:
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: catalogue-db
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue-db:0.3.0
          ports:
            - name: mysql
              containerPort: 3306
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: catalogue-db-secret
                  key: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD
              value: "true"
            - name: MYSQL_DATABASE
              value: socksdb
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 5Gi
---
```
